metadata.title: Super Micro Stock Surges on Strong AI Demand. Why Chip Investors Remain Cautious.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Super Micro Stock Surges on Strong AI Demand. Why Chip Investors Remain Cautious.
Super Micro Computer shares jumped 13% in premarket trading Wednesday after the AI-server maker said preliminary quarterly revenue would significantly exceed its previous forecast. But the good news delivered only a modest lift to chip stocks, which are still struggling to recover from a bruising selloff.
